propositions: A new `rebar metrics` CLI subcommand must parse `--since`, `--until`, and `--output json|text` flags to render the full metric registry over a specified date range.
The command must evaluate every `MetricSpec` in `REGISTRY` by constructing a context object with `repo_root`, `since`, and `until`, and calling `registry.evaluate(spec, ctx)` for each metric.
Registry hydration requires importing the `rebar.metrics` package (not just `rebar.metrics.registry`) so that reader module side-effects populate `REGISTRY` before evaluation.
The command must wrap each metric evaluation in try-except to render failed metrics as `unavailable` with a short error reason, ensuring every registered id appears in output.

JSON output (default) must emit `{"since": str, "until": str, "metrics": {id: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}, ...}}` and text output must list one metric per line in registry order.
The command implementation must not import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` modules; adapter-backed data reaches the command only via `REGISTRY` and snapshot store.
